scientific_integrity: Analytic dominated-convergence proof; finite checks supplementary. Constructing and fixed-distortion theorems are credited to original sources.
scientific_limitations: Only the open exponent interval and the explicit harmonic Koebe shear; no endpoint law or universal whole-class extremality. Priority risk from potentially unindexed earlier asymptotics and a related unexamined full text.
title: Sharp weighted Bergman crossover for the quasiconformal harmonic Koebe shear
